newsitem.title: UK: Aluminium at crossroads, copper to fall-Waterside.
newsitem.headline: Aluminium at crossroads, copper to fall-Waterside.

text.p: Aluminium is at a crossroads, with the possibility of climbing to fresh highs around $1,830 per tonne or declining to $1,578, broker Waterside Futures said in its latest report.
In any case, the three months market is strong enough to hold above recent lows, it added.
"The major support area at $1,542/44, traded in April, June and July, is not expected to be seen again," said the Wavetrack report, which uses Elliott Wave analysis.
"The strength of the advance following these lows are confirming the bullish outlook."
The market found support on Monday around $1,652, representing a Fibonacci 50-percent retracement of the rise from $1,544 in July to $1,772 in early August.
If Monday's low holds, then the market was in good shape to head higher. The upside target for this fifth wave would be $1,830, the report said.
Alternatively, the market may only sustain a rise to $1,698, a 38.2 percent Fibonacci move, then violate $1,652 support on its way to a low of $1,578.
In both cases, prices would eventually resume a strong uptrend, with medium-term targets from $2,412 to $2,461.
In copper, more weakness was expected with interim targets at $2,091 to $2,062 and a final thrust down as low as $1,982.
This was part of a five-wave pattern of declines from recent highs at $2,392, which was a counter-trend move, the report said.
"A reversal at $1,982 is forecast to signal the beginning of a new bullish sequence, with targets towards $2,852 some months later," it added.
Zinc has completed a counter-trend rally to $1,555 and has begun a new series of declines, Wavetrack said.
The recent $1,380 low should be broken over the next few weeks, with interim targets down to $1,290, and maybe as low as $1,234.
A confirmation of the down move would be a break of $1,458, the report added.
There is an outside chance that prices will remain above this key level, which would imply a move up to $1,607.
